1911 yılında kurulan Tsinghua Üniversite: Founded in 1911, Tsinghua University combines research with interdisciplinary education in Beijing. Its green campus and academic breadth span engineering, the humanities and beyond.
Peking University, Pekin konumunda eğiti: Peking University is featured for students exploring study options in Beijing. Compare academic fields, teaching languages and admissions requirements in its official catalog.
Fudan University, Şanghay konumunda eğit: Fudan University is featured for students considering studying in Shanghai. Compare academic fields, teaching languages and admissions requirements in its official catalog.
Shanghai University, Şanghay’da çok alan: Shanghai University offers programs across several academic disciplines in Shanghai. Its international admissions portal provides information on degree levels, teaching languages and required documents.
Xi’an Jiaotong University, Xi’an’da bulu: Located in Xi’an, Xi’an Jiaotong University is affiliated with China's Ministry of Education. Explore its academic structure and international student guidance for engineering, science and management.
Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Şanghay’d: Shanghai Jiao Tong University combines teaching and research in Shanghai. Its official overview covers campuses, academic units and international partnerships.
Hangzhou’daki Zhejiang University’nin kö: Zhejiang University in Hangzhou traces its origins to the Qiushi Academy, founded in 1897. Its official website provides information on programs across faculties and the international campus.
University of Science and Technology of: The University of Science and Technology of China is a science- and technology-focused university in Hefei. Its official overview describes its research fields and academic structure.
Nanjing University, eğitim, araştırma ve: Nanjing University is a comprehensive institution spanning education, research and community engagement. Explore its academic departments in Nanjing according to your intended degree level.
Wuhan University’nin geçmişi 1893’te kur: Wuhan University traces its history to the Ziqiang Institute, established in 1893. Its official catalog outlines academic disciplines and international study opportunities in Wuhan.
Sendai’deki Tohoku Üniversitesi, araştır: Tohoku University in Sendai combines research and teaching. Explore its faculties and research centres across the Aobayama campus and other sites in the city.
Fukuoka’daki Kyushu Üniversitesi’nin Ito: Kyushu University's main Ito campus is in Fukuoka. Consult its current catalogs for engineering, science and design programs.
Tokyo’daki Hosei Üniversitesi farklı kam: Hosei University teaches across several campuses in Tokyo. Check its international education pages for current English-taught degree options.
Tokyo’daki Sophia Üniversitesi, İngilizc: Sophia University in Tokyo also offers English-taught degree programs. Check individual programs' languages of instruction and entry requirements on its official admissions pages.
NUCB, Aichi bölgesinde işletme eğitimine: NUCB focuses on business education in Aichi Prefecture. Its main undergraduate campus is in Nisshin, with additional campus facilities in central Nagoya.
Kyungbok University’nin Namyangju yerleş: Kyungbok University's official pages introduce its Namyangju campus and student housing options. Confirm available departments and international admissions requirements directly with the institution.
Suwon Women’s University; hemşirelik, sa: Suwon Women's University lists nursing, health and food sciences, social studies and arts among its academic areas. It has Inje and Haeran campuses.
Gumi University’nin bölüm sayfalarında v: Gumi University's department pages introduce applied fields such as tax accounting. Check the teaching language and international admissions requirements for your chosen department.
1940’a uzanan geçmişiyle Daejeon Institu: Tracing its history to 1940, Daejeon Institute of Science and Technology emphasises vocational and applied education. Its English website covers student services and scholarship information.
1905’te bir tıp okulu olarak başlayan NU: Founded as a medical school in 1905, NUS is now a multidisciplinary research university in Singapore. Besides its main Kent Ridge campus, it has campuses at Bukit Timah and Outram.
Nanyang Technological University, Singap: Nanyang Technological University is a technology-focused teaching and research university in Singapore. Compare engineering, computing and other disciplines at the individual program level.
Singapore Management University, Singapu: Singapore Management University brings together management, social sciences and technology at its city-centre campus. Connections with industry and public organisations form part of its educational approach.
1911 yılında kurulan HKU, Hong Kong’daki: Founded in 1911, HKU is one of Hong Kong's established research universities. Its faculties cover architecture, engineering, health, social sciences, business and more.
PolyU’nun mühendislik, bilim ve tasarım: PolyU has faculties and schools covering engineering, science, design and other fields. Explore applied disciplines and programs at its Hong Kong campus.
CityUHK; işletme, bilgisayar, mühendisli: CityUHK comprises colleges and schools in business, computing, engineering, social sciences, creative media and more. Check admissions requirements for your specific program.
1991’de kurulan HKUST, Hong Kong’da araş: Established in 1991, HKUST is a research-focused university in Hong Kong. Explore its academic units and admissions options in science, technology and engineering.
1963’te kurulan CUHK, iki dilli ve çok k: Founded in 1963, CUHK is a bilingual, multicultural university with study options across arts, business, engineering, medicine, science and social sciences.
